propositions: The per-criterion fan-out recovery design exhausts token budget (440 requests worst case vs 240 primary) and wall-clock time (sequential 25-90s per criterion) without optimizing banked verdicts, causing verdict-less failures when recovery itself dies.
A primary run that verifies 20 of 22 criteria before exhausting budget has its verified work discarded wholesale, requiring re-verification in successor runs.

The flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 floor hands low-criteria tickets (e.g., 8 criteria) ~10x the budget they need, manufacturing exhaustion that recovery then remediates; a criteria-scaled floor verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c,48,480) prevents runaway.
Read_file memo keys on exact (path, line_start, line_end) so 77% of re-reads at different ranges bypass the memo cache, wasting budget; normalizing by path alone collapses this tax.

Recovery must emit full-coverage verdicts (banked criteria scored, unbanked as met=false placeholders) and never verdict-less states, with a deterministic no-LLM fallback if the finalizer fails twice.
